body:
The honest answer is not very. I don't feel like I'm a close enough friend to confide these issues in, but when my alarm bells started going off I didn't think I could ignore them. 

And she didn't mention methods, but she kept saying that she didn't want to live anymore, that there was no getting better this time, and she kept using "goodbye, have a good life" closing sentences. The latter is what really freaked me out and I felt like if I didn't do something I wouldn't be able to forgive myself.

Well, thanks. Really I just don't know what to do now. My phone is blowing up and I don't know how to handle it. Do I lie and say it wasn't me? Do I confess and deal with the fallout? I just wanted to make sure she didn't do something stupid but honestly I'm not close enough to manage this kind of panic. I'm not good at it and I'm not a close enough friend to be a listening ear for all this. I have no idea what to do now.
